name: Replace HVAC filter
description: Replace the HVAC air filter to ensure efficiency and air quality.
climate_zone_notes: Important for 6a due to heavy use in both summer and winter.

name: Clean garbage disposal
description: Clean disposal with ice cubes and baking soda/vinegar.

name: Check water softener salt
description: Ensure salt levels are adequate to prevent hard water scaling.

name: Test sump pump
description: Pour water into the basin to ensure the pump activates.
climate_zone_notes: Crucial for KC area due to spring rains and rapid snowmelt.

name: Check fire extinguishers
description: Verify pressure gauges and ensure extinguishers are accessible.

name: Flush water heater sediment
description: Drain a few gallons to clear sediment and maintain efficiency.

name: Clean range hood filter
description: Degrease the filter over the stove.

name: Test A/C system
description: Turn on A/C before it gets hot to ensure it cools properly.
climate_zone_notes: KC summers get very hot; early testing avoids rush season.

name: Roof inspection
description: Check for missing/damaged shingles after winter storms.

name: Gutter clean (Spring)
description: Clear spring debris/seed pods to prevent water damage.

name: Termite inspection
description: Professional inspection for termite activity.

name: Fertilize lawn
description: Apply pre-emergent and fertilizer.

name: Dethatch & aerate
description: Improve soil drainage and reduce thatch buildup.

name: Check outdoor faucets
description: Check for winter freeze damage / cracked pipes.
climate_zone_notes: Zone 6a freezes often cause spigot damage.

name: Clean window wells (Spring)
description: Remove leaves and debris to ensure proper drainage.

name: Check irrigation system
description: Run zones and fix broken sprinkler heads.

name: Clean dryer vent
description: Clear lint from the exhaust duct to prevent fire risk.

name: Inspect caulking & weather stripping
description: Check windows and doors for gaps.

name: Power-wash siding & deck
description: Remove mold, mildew, and grime.

name: Check A/C refrigerant
description: Ensure A/C is charged and running efficiently.

name: Trim trees away from house
description: Keep branches at least 5 feet from roof and siding.

name: Furnace tune-up
description: Professional inspection and cleaning of heating system.

name: Gutter clean (Fall)
description: Clear autumn leaves to prevent ice dams and water damage.

name: Winterize sprinklers
description: Blow out irrigation lines to prevent freezing.

name: Reverse ceiling fans
description: Set to clockwise to push warm air down.

name: Seal driveway cracks
description: Prevent water from freezing and expanding cracks.
climate_zone_notes: Freeze/thaw cycles in KC are brutal on concrete.

name: Chimney inspection
description: Check for creosote buildup and blockages.

name: Clean window wells (Fall)
description: Remove leaf debris before winter.

name: Test smoke & CO detectors
description: Replace batteries and test alarms.

name: Check water heater anode rod
description: Inspect and replace if corroded to extend tank life.

name: Insulate exposed pipes
description: Add foam insulation to unheated pipes.
climate_zone_notes: Crucial during KC sub-zero cold snaps.

name: Check attic insulation
description: Ensure adequate coverage for energy efficiency.

name: Check for ice dams
description: Monitor roof edges after heavy snow.
climate_zone_notes: Common in Zone 6a with fluctuating winter temps.
